description: Missing building regulations certificate; indemnity insurance agreed; amount in words.

segments.text: The seller's solicitors have confirmed there's no building regulations certificate for the kitchen extension.
It can be. The usual solution is a single indemnity insurance policy, which protects you and the lender. The quote is one hundred and eighty pounds.
That's fine, please go ahead and arrange it.
I'll arrange the policy today and it will be in place before exchange.
